title: The Pilot Who Saw Freedom Behind Prison Walls with Blake Raney
summary: Blake Raney, founder of SPAIRROW, joins Jed Chappell to talk about aviation, calling, business as service, and what he saw the first time he walked into a prison. From Oklahoma City entrepreneurship to his daughter Kennedy’s heart surgery, Blake reflects on faith, fatherhood, accountability, and building a foundation before life’s storms arrive.
